Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: aerial, facing street, fov 90
- highway road, 1-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks absent, curbs absent
- driveways: right; parking: none
- commercial building at center, 1 story, wood, brick, metal, pitched roof, shallow setback
- utilities: power lines, utility poles
- landscape: bare soil
- immutable elements: mountain
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 2025
Post-pandemic era. A 2025 fuel stop — LED canopy, full-color digital price sign, and a convenience store selling fresh food.

CONDITION: abandoned — closed business, boarded windows, weeds through pavement cracks, weathered surfaces

PERIOD DETAILS
- free air and vacuum station at the lot edge
- large convenience store with 'FRESH FOOD — MADE TO ORDER' branding
- main sign: a bare stripped sign frame — rusted metal posts, an empty price panel with no digits, no lit letters, no logo, all branding gone
- window signs: 'COLD BREW $3.99', 'MEMBERS SAVE 10¢/GAL'
- stacked bags of ice and firewood outside
- stacked delivery boxes by the store door
Typography: minimalist geometric sans-serif, heavily simplified flat logos.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
NO people anywhere — the place is completely deserted.

VEHICLES
NO vehicles anywhere — empty lot, no parked or moving cars.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: worn and faded, well past their last repainting
- utilities: overhead lines in older areas, underground in new developments, fiber optic widespread

DECAY
- rusted signage askew, lettering broken off
- lane markings nearly gone, faint paint traces
- graffiti on boarded panels, lower wall
Wear is surfaces only — road, curbs, footprints, camera unchanged.
TREES
- deciduous tree at left: young tree, thin trunk
- deciduous tree at right: young tree, thin trunk
- deciduous tree at background: maturing tree
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — digital — smartphone or mirrorless camera look.
Color: high saturation. Grain: very clean, minimal to no noise.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
